source.note: Migrated from the original WordPress release post. v2.x patches use Xdelta3 — apply with Delta Patcher (https://www.romhacking.net/utilities/704/). v1.x line was a different tool (Enchanted Translator Lite + Translation.dat) and is kept for archival reference only.

instructions: Run the MD5 command above on your ROM to figure out which revision you have.
Download the patch file that matches your ROM's MD5 hash.
Set "XDelta patch" to the .xdelta file you downloaded.
Click "Apply patch". A new patched .nds file appears in the same folder.

releases.headline: Menu crashes fixed — friend menu, sing/hum, clothing codec, and bug-register no longer crash or freeze the game.
releases.summary: A stability-focused round. Four menus that were crashing or freezing the game are fixed, the music menu's song titles got a proper retranslation pass, and a batch of dialogs where the body text was silently disappearing has been restored.
changes: Menu crashes fixed — friend menu, sing/hum, clothing codec, and bug-register no longer crash or freeze the game.
Song titles in the music menu retranslated — "Cottage Cheese" (which was a translation drift from なついろのコテージ) is now "Summer Cottage", and 28 other songs got similar corrections.
Bug book / fish book / NPC dialog where the body text disappeared and the menu fired immediately is fixed — 15 dialogs restored.
Berry's shop name fixed from "Berries" to "Berry's" in the friend-chat menu.
releases.notes: Two patch variants offered per ROM revision. Both behave identically in-game. **regular** = larger file (extra ~5 KB), simpler internals. **compressed** = smaller, mirrors original Konami storage shape. Pick by preference.
releases.revGuidance: Rev 1 is the most common dump; if your ROM filename has 'Rev 1' in it, use Rev 1. Otherwise use Rev 0.

releases.headline: Magic keyboard in English, name cleanup, less ROM bloat
releases.summary: A bunch of polish stuff this round. The magic-glyph keyboard is finally in English, a pile of inconsistent NPC names and currency labels got unified, and there's a fix in the ROM build that drops the patched file size by about 1.57 MB (which should help with the lag a few people reported).
changes: Magic-glyph keyboard is in English. All 377 spell glyphs (incantation, magic, charm, the lot) now show their English equivalents on the on-screen keyboard.

Overlay menus translated. The ARM9 + UI overlay menu pools (26 arm9 strings and 6 overlays: 47/59/65/96/170/171) now show English for things like Show BGM, Magic, OK, Equip, Remake, Picks, Stories, Hangout, Fashion, Style Check, Go shopping, To school, Trends, Reviews, Berries, Errand?, Like this? (Y/N) — the NPC interaction menu, equip/remake prompts, and the small UI strings that used to stay in Japanese.

NPC name consistency pass. Some characters had their names translated differently across dialog lines — the cat NPC is now "Charlie" everywhere, the dorm shop NPC is "Malila" everywhere, etc. 104 fixes across the corpus.
Currency is "Ritch" everywhere. It was drifting between "Ritch" and "Ricci" in different files. Now it's just Ritch.
Princess Sol / Principal Sol typo fixed. The Principal's NPC label was showing as "Pricipal" — fixed in the binary, so the speaker tag reads correctly now.
King is "His Majesty" again. 27 dialog lines were calling the king "Her Majesty" because the JP was gender-neutral and got translated wrong. Fixed.

Linguistics class label is consistent. The class まほうご (literally "magic words") is now called "Linguistics" wherever it shows up as a class name. References to the actual magic language being spoken still read as "magic words" / "magic language" — that's the in-fiction language, not the class.

UCC cooking recipe names are translated. All 14 of them: Cake, Shortcake, Stew, Beef Stew, Pasta, Carbonara, Napolitan, Red Bean Bun, Choco Bun, Cream Bun, Jam Bun, Ice Cream, Vanilla Ice Cream, Bread.
Magic license card fixed. The student ID card was showing entire sentences in fields that should have been short labels (Birthday, the Witch's Nose constellation, etc.) — corrected to actual labels.
Opening tutorial menu cleanup. Three menu options were showing long sentences instead of short option names — fixed.
Past Class / Special Class menu options renamed.
Constellation names use Game 1 canon (Witch's Nose, Bat's Wing, Scale Tail, etc.).
401 dialog overflow fixes. Lines that were too wide for the textbox got re-wrapped, and 51 of them got light rewrites to fit. Most are just line-break tweaks, no wording changes.
ROM size fix. There was a bug in the build that was bloating message files. Cutting that out drops the patched ROM by about 1.57 MB, which should help with the lag some people reported.

Misc canon corrections. 104 more dialog lines updated where the JP referenced something that has established English canon — e.g. "Mr. Graves" was being used incorrectly for one NPC line and got fixed.
releases.notes: Patches for both ROM revisions are included. The Rev 0 patch bundles the Nintendo Rev 1 fixes so both endings produce the same patched ROM.

releases.headline: AI retranslation + Freedomuniverse fixes
releases.summary: Full retranslation of game text using current AI with proper dialog context. Imported Freedomuniverse's friend-code crash fix, repaired 18 broken menus, and patched text overruns on bug info screens.
changes: Retranslated game dialog using a current AI model with much better dialog-context handling.
Bug fix: imported Freedomuniverse's edits for the friend code. Should prevent crashing when tapping it.
Bug fix: fixed 18 broken menus.
Bug fix: fixed text overruns on some bug information screens.
releases.notes: I patch off Rev 1, so if you have Rev 0 it will also include all the Nintendo bug fixes.

releases.headline: Terminator fix for merged dialog
releases.summary: Fixed an issue with missing terminators causing dialog to merge together and overflow.
changes: Bug fix: missing terminators were causing adjacent dialog to merge together and overflow.

releases.headline: First Xdelta3 release
releases.summary: Switched the patch format from the old custom tool to Xdelta3. Pick the patch that matches your ROM revision.
changes: Switched patch format to Xdelta3, patched against Rev 1.

legacy.summary: The original patch system, before Xdelta3. Used a separate patcher tool and a database file with the translation. Roughly 5% human-translated, 95% DeepL. Kept here for historical reference; the v2.x Xdelta patches above replace it.
